direct_context_observation: Common players/ai dropdown invokes selectAIForComputers. Subjects include both Computer and Shared controller colonies; individual choices remain editable. The field is maxWidth720/textpoint and uses a wrapping field label.
rationale: संगणकनियंत्रित explicitly conveys computer-controlled colonies, correcting the raw draft’s ambiguous संगणक वसाहती. सर्व retains applicability to all such colonies. एआय is an established Marathi technical acronym and a precise compact alternative to the existing full संगणकीय खेळाडू label; it names the strategy/controller choice rather than merging colony owners. No implicit promise that human-controlled colonies are changed.
limits: Actual canonical1-key reread only. No fresh full native catalog reread or rendering assertion. Prior3411 translations unchanged and carry requires its separate proof.
